input.answer:
Overall consumer prices in Canada were rising at about 3.1% in September 2026 compared with September 2025.

Calculation (CPI, All-items, Canada, not seasonally adjusted, 2002=100):
- September 2025: 164.9
- September 2026: 170.0
- Change: 170.0 − 164.9 = 5.1
- Percent change: 5.1 / 164.9 = 0.0309 → 3.1%

Note: this is computed from the index levels in StatCan table 18-10-0004. The 12-month rate is what StatCan publishes as the headline inflation figure, and it matches this calculation.

answer_values.label: change_pct
answer_values.description: Year-over-year change in the all-items CPI, Canada (not seasonally adjusted), computed from 164.9 (Sep 2025) to 170.0 (Sep 2026)
